notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public aflac.com pages only (no sign-in, no form submitted; the MyAflac FAQ PDF could not be opened - the server forces a download - so its menu path 'My Account > Billing & Direct Deposit > Make payment / Set up autopay' is from a search-result summary and is used only for nav wording). Contact page: register and log in to view and manage policies, submit and track claims, make payments and update account info; registration uses SSN + mobile phone or policy/certificate number (not expressible in registrationFields); direct deposit for claims under Billing or My Account; mail payments per the Payment Remittance Instructions with the account/policy number; Customer Solutions Center 800-992-3522; Aflac New York 800-366-3436; Aflac Group 800-433-3036; Tier One 866-990-2668; chat 24/7. Aflac Always page: when payroll deduction ends, keep coverage at the same rate by switching to bank draft (ACH), debit or credit card through MyAflac or the agent; no extra cost; first draft on the day (1-28) chosen at sign-up; frequency monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual (only monthly modelled). Guest payment is not documented on the public pages reviewed. No fees published. autopay.note: Choose bank draft (ACH), debit card or credit card and the day of the month (1-28) for your draft. We notify you before the first draft.

guest_pay.note: To pay your premium without logging in to MyAflac, call the Aflac Customer Solutions Center at 800-992-3522 or mail your payment with your Aflac account or policy number on the check or money order.

help.title: Paying your Aflac premium
paragraphs: Log in to MyAflac to view and manage your policies, make payments and update your account information. Don't have an account? Register with your Social Security and mobile phone number, or your policy or certificate number.
To pay by mail, follow Aflac's Payment Remittance Instructions and write your Aflac account or policy number on your check or money order.
Questions? Chat with us online 24/7 or call the Aflac Customer Solutions Center at 800-992-3522.

help.title: Keep your coverage with Aflac Always
paragraphs: If you change jobs, retire or your employer stops payroll deductions, Aflac Always lets you keep your existing coverage at the same rate by paying directly. It costs nothing extra and you do not need to requalify medically.

Sign up in MyAflac under My Account, or with your agent. Pay by bank draft (ACH), debit card or credit card, monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually. Your first draft is usually taken on the day of the month (1-28) you pick, after payroll deductions end, and we let you know before it starts.
If payroll deductions end and no other payment method is set up, your policy may lapse.

help.title: What you can do on MyAflac
paragraphs: View and manage your policies, file and track claims, see status changes, enroll in Aflac Always and find your agent's contact information.

Policy changes such as changing a beneficiary, adding or removing a person, or reinstating a policy start from My Policies, then Policy Summary/Forms/History. Sign up for direct deposit of claim payments from the Billing page.

help.title: Contact Aflac
paragraphs: Aflac Customer Solutions Center: 800-992-3522. Aflac New York: 800-366-3436. Aflac Group: 800-433-3036. Aflac Tier One (8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET, Monday to Friday): 866-990-2668.
Online chat is available 24/7 for common questions.

extra.intent: Find the phone number of the Aflac Customer Solutions Center. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Any day from 1 to 28 (1-28) of the month, chosen at sign-up.
